candidates.title: Continuum: Efficient and Robust Multi-Turn LLM Agent Scheduling with KV Cache Time-to-Live
candidates.reason: Agentic serving system combining tool-duration-aware KV-cache TTL with program-level scheduling. It directly targets multi-turn tool-call pauses, cache retention/offload decisions, and job completion time, with real agent workloads and multiple hardware/offload settings.

discovery_stats.axis: agentic multi-turn scheduling / tool-call pauses / KV cache TTL
discovery_stats.query_summary: Moved from generic batching to agentic multi-turn serving. SPECTRE, SPIN, and SwiftSpec were already known in the recent discovery history; Continuum was not found by repository code search and has a distinct tool-aware cache-retention and program-scheduling contribution.
